messages.subject: Caldervale's Defence and Counterclaim served
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Nadia,

Caldervale served its Defence and Counterclaim yesterday. As expected, it denies liability, says Milestone 4 was conditional on acceptance, defends the termination as lawful, and counterclaims £2.1m (peak-season losses £1.18m, remediation £265k, replacement system £655k).

Nothing in it surprises us, and the counterclaim's replacement-system head looks weak on mitigation/betterment. Our reply will press the dependency failures. Happy to walk you through it on a call.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Caldervale's Defence and Counterclaim served
messages.plaintextBody:
Thanks Sarah. A call would be useful. To be clear on our side: the SKU master they gave us on 18 September was demonstrably wrong on ~22% of active SKUs and we flagged it in writing two days later. Their 'corrected by 26 September' line doesn't match our records. Let's make sure that's front and centre.

Nadia Verghese
General Counsel, Penrose Robotics
